purpose.domain_detail: NIST COBOL 85 conformance validation test suite - indexed file I/O testing (IX series). Tests file status 43 condition after reading past AT END and attempting REWRITE.
purpose.summary: This is a NIST COBOL 85 validation test program (IX120A) that tests indexed sequential file I/O behavior. It opens file IX-FS3 (created by IX113A) in I-O mode, reads sequentially until AT END, then reads once more and attempts a REWRITE to verify that file status 43 is returned and declaratives are triggered. It is part of the standard NIST conformance test suite.

Indexed file with FILE STATUS clause
